description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility operations, ensuring the highest standards of quality care, regulatory compliance, and financial performance. Your leadership will be crucial in fostering a positive culture for both residents and staff, driving continuous improvement initiatives.This full-time position comes with a highly competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to delivering outstanding outcomes and enhancing the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Strong financial acumen, operational management, and team leadership abilities.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility as an MDS Coordinator in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, which are crucial for resident care planning and facility reimbursement.As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a key role in the interdisciplinary team, collaborating with nursing, therapy, and other departments to develop comprehensive care plans that meet the individual needs of our residents. Your expertise will ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, contributing significantly to the quality of care provided.This full-time opportunity offers an annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000. If you are a detail-oriented RN with a passion for geriatric care and regulatory compliance, we encourage you to apply and become a part of a team committed to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
RAC-CT certification preferred or willingness to obtain.
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to MDS and care planning.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
Join a dynamic multi-specialty medical practice in New York City, NY, seeking a dedicated Family Medicine MD. This role offers a unique opportunity to focus on workers' compensation and no-fault/lien cases, providing essential care to a diverse patient population. We are looking for a physician who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality patient outcomes.

This position is structured with a compensation package that is very heavy on bonuses, complementing a competitive base salary. Candidates must be prepared for weekend work to meet patient needs. If you are a physician with a strong background in workers' compensation and a desire to make a significant impact without the complexities of major medical insurances or Medicare/Medicaid, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) degree and valid New York State medical license
Must be Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) certified
Proven experience with workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases
Ability to work weekends as required
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is very heavy on bonuses, less on salary.
